title: Page 81
transc:
Ft. Monroe Apr 23. 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
for honor able Henry Wilson Senator grapes unity please
have no action taken at present upon maxims confirm
nation if he is likely to be rejected zodiac
his Pelham is ordered hear & I should not
like to change Polkers just now webster Knox Eugenia
zebra Another from animal april harrow perfume for princess
fox assistant Burton growl zebra I think you can
do more good to the sir vice by coming
here for harsh pension hours than any where else
Pekin please break fast with me whelp morning Emma
perhaps you can bring Bolivia with you walrus Knave
Geo D Sheldon


Ft. Monroe April 23. 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Indian Borgia growl unity I have received by the
hands of paradise Cutts a plation in relation to the
french vessels zodiac the tenor of the note torch French
charg is equivalent to saying that a tambour is pending
up Bergen which is to be plated to the consul
at Galway zebra the time having expired wedge limited by
the convention for shipping the tobacco May I no be
permitted to notify the french polker at blubber that the
time has so expired & therefore he is to come
down at once & deliver the despatches torch french minister
to him after his arrival at appian youth Knave Fanny
Geo D Sheldon
